artifacts.summary: Confirms merge.lua's append_index_entries upserts index entries by path (whole-entry replace, no per-field merge); documents the lean contracts/adversarial-verification.md single-agent entry as the named defect; audits all extensions and finds two more core/lean pairs with the identical shape (reference-grounding.md, anti-analysis.md) plus a distinct same-file duplicate in cslib's own index-entries.json (ci-pipeline.md); recommends the union-valued load_when.agents fix proven by task 1000's cslib precedent, verified via actual merge reconstruction.

memory_candidates.content: In this repo's extension system, lua/neotex/plugins/ai/shared/extensions/merge.lua's M.append_index_entries upserts index.json entries strictly BY PATH: it replaces the whole matching entry object in place (no per-field merge) when two entries share a path, whether the collision is cross-extension (last-extension-processed wins) or WITHIN a single extension's own index-entries.json array (later array position wins). Any mirror/duplicate index entry for a path another extension (or the same extension, twice) also declares MUST use a union-valued load_when.agents, or a narrower entry silently drops the other's agent hook with no error anywhere. Established/proven pattern: task 1000's cslib mirror fix, verified by an actual headless-Neovim merge reconstruction rather than static JSON inspection.

check-extension-docs.sh's Rule R (source-file existence) and Rule T (forbidden load_when keys) are the only existing lint rules touching index-entries.json load_when structure, and neither detects a duplicated path across extensions (or within one extension's own file) whose load_when.agents sets are narrower than their union. This defect class is currently invisible to all automated gates in the repo; a jq one-liner over agent-system/extensions/*/index-entries.json (group by .path, flag count>1) is the manual audit technique used to surface it.
